editorial.verdict: A simple single-arm upgrade when one screen is enough and desk depth is limited.
editorial.description: Generic clamp-on single monitor arm class for small home offices that need the display off the desktop without a dual-arm footprint. Commerce uses a search destination, not a specific ASIN listing.
bestFor: Shallow apartment desktops with rear clamp clearance
notFor: Dual-monitor setups that need a dual arm
Glass or very thin tops that cannot take a clamp
pros: Frees desk depth for keyboard and notebook
Clamp install suits many rental desks
cons: Needs enough rear overhang for the clamp

review.summary: Practical first monitor-arm pick when you only need one screen lifted off a small desk.
